description: Removable-code audit of fz-go4.18.11 (2026-07-02) found .agent/docs/telemetry.md documents neither the pre-existing transport_component.produced signal nor the new executable_transport.projected signal added at 458bec93a (transport.rs emit_transport_component_materialized). Not a regression fz-go4.18.11 introduced (produced was already undocumented), but the ticket's own fold is the natural place to have closed the gap and didn't. Add telemetry.md entries for both topics: shape (ExecutableKey metadata), emission site, and what property each lets a test observe (cache-hit vs fresh-materialize distinction for the projected signal).
title: telemetry.md missing entries for transport_component.produced and executable_transport.projected
